set.st: Two hermit brothers, trappers and well-diggers, lived on a 10-acre farm 3 mi SW of Palmyra. After the last died in Nov 1926, more than $5,000 was found: old gold notes between attic timbers, gold in soldered gas-pipe cylinders under a floorboard, and more in old shoes and tin cans. Searchers suspected more, and the yard was to be dug in the spring of 1927; no report of that dig. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: Mostly recovered; more only suspected. Private: permission.
